## Toast Pattern Used

All alerts were replaced following the established pattern from `dashboard/page.tsx`:

```typescript
// Error notifications (API errors with description from server)
toast.error('Failed to [action]', {
  description: error.error || 'Unknown error occurred',
  duration: 8000
})

// Validation errors
toast.error('Validation Error', {
  description: '[validation message]',
  duration: 5000
})

// Selection required
toast.error('Selection Required', {
  description: '[instruction message]',
  duration: 5000
})
```
